scope: Second protocol prerequisite. Actual whole-head CAS/successor validation over bounded raw ACK bytes. Does not add a transport, coordinator, Current admission, recovered store binder or production caller.

source_proofs.use: Fixed publisher/sequence request identity, exact prior token, full successor head, encoded request digest, monotonic ReadHead, legal Current→Dirty→Publishing→Current transitions and changed opaque token.
Seven-field writer binding equality copied as expressions into the shared proposal validator. No otherwise-unused method added to the wire module.

Actual original ObjectiveSenderWriterFence shape; owner binding and full lease/writer digest are retained in the requested and acknowledged proposal. This codec does not independently verify the underlying lease.

behavior: decode_against first applies the real R2e2a request bounds/shape/digest validation and validates the caller-provided predecessor's wire consistency. Epoch must match; sequence must strictly exceed the last mutation; every mutation must carry the exact full prior token.

ReadHead only accepts the same owner/publisher/writer binding/peer lifetime with nonregressing counter and mutation sequence. It may return Dirty/Publishing/Fenced as observations; that is explicitly not Current admission.

For mutation ACKs, derive the complete successor by cloning the predecessor, checked-incrementing the counter, retaining the exact request ID, SHA-256 of encode() bytes, command and predecessor token, and performing only the legal three publication transitions.

Prepare and commit both check the proposal's owner/profile and the original seven writer-binding fields. Commit consumes the already-retained proposal cut. Missing or mismatched proposal data is refusal; no default Current or empty receipt is supplied.
Accept only if the entire returned head equals that expected successor and the opaque token has changed. No local JSON hash replaces the server token.

R2e2a sequence and receipt checks move unchanged into helpers now actually called from two API paths. All three prior R2e2a controls remain byte-identical; all cabc pre-existing tests and production callers remain unchanged.

meaningful_tests.transcript_scope: Synthetic fixed raw protocol frames. Request digests were calculated independently in V8 from the literal bytes, and parser/shape consistency was checked there. No protected service, transport or Rust test execution is claimed.
controls: The full three-step serialized transcript must validate, with exact encoded request byte equality and complete returned receipt equality at each step.

Keep counters valid while independently tampering phase, sequence, writer generation/expiry, peer lifetime, exact cut, retained request identity/digest/command or full predecessor token. Each actual raw ACK must be rejected; an unchanged opaque server token also rejects.

Bad expected token, foreign epoch, replay sequence, illegal phase and overflowing counter reject. Prepare rejects wrong owner/profile/generation/expiry; commit rejects missing or mismatched previously retained proposal.
ReadHead returns a valid Fenced observation without converting it into Current, while writer/lifetime changes and counter/sequence rollback reject.
meaningful_tests.no_baseline_claim: New codec API input negatives; absence of the API in cabc is not a runnable baseline failure. All Rust tests remain unexecuted.

dependencies_and_lock_gate.compile: R2e2a plus existing Memory/contracts/serde/serde_json/sha2. No new Cargo/Bazel dependency, binary, compile_data, lock or cfg change.
dependencies_and_lock_gate.integration: No compile dependence on R1/R2a/R2c/R2d/R2e1. Real production use remains blocked on the actual authenticated transport, serialized receipt ownership, uncertainty/cancel fence and consuming exact recovery/three-pool binder.
dependencies_and_lock_gate.caller_rule: Future owner coordinator must choose legal transitions before sending over its authenticated fixed peer, own request sequencing and hold its receipt mutex over the exchange. decode_against validates content after reception; it does not itself send, allocate IDs, serialize concurrent callers, enforce time, authenticate a Root or hold SQLite locks.

preservation.original_sender_bootstrap_and_duplicates: Agentd production_composition generic attachment, original_sender, bootstrap ACK and R2e1 exact duplicate rollback+original independent ACK untouched.
preservation.windows_and_readonly: All retained-directory/private-state-sync/ordinary peer/Windows permission behavior untouched. No hook protection claimed for provided read-only pools.

required_commands.scope: Sole native executor only, after root review. Actual fresh JUnit/roster/source/platform/terminal receipts required; no counts or passes inferred.
